details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:102 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The helper reports success on credential hide or restore failures, so callers can proceed with credentials exposed or unavailable.
  WHY: Hide and restore error paths, including stale markers, marker creation failures, missing GH_TOKEN, and restore failures, return success instead of signaling a failed credential boundary.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:78-93 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore injects GH_TOKEN based on the GitHub host without verifying that the origin still identifies the workflow's original repository or a trusted support checkout.
  WHY: An editor can change origin to an attacker-controlled GitHub repository, which passes the host check and receives the token.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:29-54 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The helper does not reject remote.origin.pushurl or url.*.pushInsteadOf redirects.
  WHY: A redirect can route a later credentialed push to an attacker-controlled destination despite the origin URL handling.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:85-93 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore can reinstate extraheaders under generic or attacker-scoped GitHub URL keys rather than restricting them to the verified repository origin.
  WHY: Git requests beyond the verified repository can receive the restored authorization header.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:61-97 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Restore processes checkouts sequentially and injects credentials before validating every target checkout.
  WHY: If a later checkout fails validation, an earlier checkout has already received the token.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:38-39 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The PR-branch allowlist change is unavailable to the review run, which executes the verified support copy from main.
  WHY: That support copy still filters out scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh, preventing the helper from being transferred in the review workspace.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2889-2896, 4516-4520, 4591 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The editor can create Git hooks in .git that execute during later credentialed commit or push operations.
  WHY: Those later Git operations can invoke editor-created hooks with credentials and network access, bypassing the editor environment scrub and issue-scoped commit checks.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2889-2896 and 4160-4163 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The editor retains access to GITHUB_ENV and can use it to alter the environment of later credentialed steps.
  WHY: An editor can write a BASH_ENV assignment and an external script path to GITHUB_ENV, causing later Bash steps with GH_TOKEN to run the script.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The credential helper rejects failed hides/restores and restores auth only when the origin still names the workflow's original repository (or its trusted support checkout) and its push URL agrees, not an editor-changed GitHub destination; generic GitHub extraheaders are restored scoped to the verified origin only."
  expected_change_site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The helper unconditionally exits 0, does not validate GITHUB_REPOSITORY identity or pushurl/pushInsteadOf, does not scope restored extraheaders to the verified origin, and does not pre-validate all checkouts; tests in tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py assert these missing checks.
- requirement: The template copy of pr_merge_status_guard.py in workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py must remain identical to .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py.
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  EVIDENCE: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py has changes for exit handling, += environment assignment parsing, remote_provided, and destination == HEAD, while workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py only has redirect and unresolved refspec changes; test_template_copies_are_identical() in tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py will fail.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:102 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The helper exits 0 on hide and restore failures, so callers cannot detect failed credential-boundary operations.
  WHY: Credentials can remain available to the editor after a failed hide, or remain stripped for later pushes after a failed restore; the cited contract tests assert nonzero return codes.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:81 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Restore checks only that origin starts with https://github.com/ and does not validate the original repository identity.
  WHY: An editor can change origin to an attacker repository on GitHub and receive the injected GH_TOKEN.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:21-23 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Hide returns success when a stale marker exists.
  WHY: The editor proceeds despite hide doing nothing; test_hide_fails_when_an_unrestored_marker_exists asserts a nonzero return code.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:57-59 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Restore returns success when GH_TOKEN is absent.
  WHY: Credentials remain stripped and later git push operations cannot authenticate.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:85-93 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Restore re-injects GH_TOKEN into the original extraheader key, including attacker-scoped GitHub paths.
  WHY: An attacker-scoped extraheader can receive the fresh credential; test_restore_rejects_untrusted_extraheader_scope expects rejection.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:29-54 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Hide does not check pushurl redirects or pushInsteadOf rewrites.
  WHY: A later push can bypass the origin URL; the cited tests expect hide to reject these configurations.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:61-97 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Restore validates and injects credentials checkout by checkout instead of validating all checkouts first.
  WHY: An earlier checkout can retain an injected token when a later checkout fails validation.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:25-27 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Hide returns success when marker-file creation fails.
  WHY: The editor proceeds without an established credential boundary, and restore has no marker to read.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:38-43 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Hide continues after failing to remove credentials from the origin URL.
  WHY: The editor can run with the credential still embedded in the origin.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "The credential helper rejects failed hides/restores and restores auth only when the origin still names the workflow's original repository (or its trusted support checkout) and its push URL agrees, not an editor-changed GitHub destination; generic GitHub extraheaders are restored scoped to the verified origin only." (from README.md and agents.md PR description)
  Expected change site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh
  Evidence of absence: The helper at HEAD unconditionally exits 0 on line 102. It does not validate GITHUB_REPOSITORY, does not check remote.origin.pushurl or url.*.pushInsteadOf, and does not re-scope restored extraheaders to the verified origin repository path. Multiple tests in tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py expect these checks.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:78-95 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Restore validates only the GitHub host, not the repository identity, and does not inspect remote.origin.pushurl or pushInsteadOf.
  WHY: An editor can redirect origin or pushurl to an attacker repository and cause GH_TOKEN to be injected or sent there.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:85-93 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Restored extraheaders are not restricted to the verified repository origin.
  WHY: Generic or attacker-scoped GitHub extraheaders can send authorization to other GitHub endpoints.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:2889-2896, 4516-4520, 4591 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The editor can write .git/hooks/pre-push or .git/hooks/pre-commit scripts that run during later credentialed Git operations.
  WHY: Those hooks can use network access and credentials, bypassing the editor environment scrub.
- tests/test_heal_evidence_editor_isolation.py: test_hide_rejects_preexisting_push_url_rewrite (lines 93-102) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test expects hide to reject pushInsteadOf rewrites and preserve the embedded credential, but the helper does not check pushInsteadOf, strips the credential, and exits 0.
  WHY: Running the cited test fails its return-code and configuration assertions.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:61-97 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Restore modifies checkouts sequentially without first validating all target checkouts.
  WHY: A later checkout validation failure leaves credentials already written to an earlier checkout.
- scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh:23, 27, 43, 51, 59, 102 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The helper exits 0 on error paths in hide and restore.
  WHY: Callers cannot detect failed isolation or restoration, and the cited tests expect nonzero return codes.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:38-39 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR's allowlist change is unavailable to review_autofix.yml, which executes the verified workflow support copy from main.
  WHY: That copy still rejects paths containing "credential", so the helper is dropped during review workspace transfer.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Pass allowlisted, structured diagnostics rather than raw log instructions to the editor; run it without credentials or network access and enforce automated issue-scoped write restrictions, where the credential helper rejects failed hides/restores and restores auth only when the origin still names the workflow's original repository and its push URL agrees.
  Expected change site: scripts/editor_git_credentials.sh
  Evidence of absence: The helper is 102 lines and unconditionally exits 0. It does not validate GITHUB_REPOSITORY identity, check remote.origin.pushurl or pushInsteadOf, scope extraheader restoration to the verified repository origin, or pre-validate all checkouts; cited tests expect these checks.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The template copy of pr_merge_status_guard.py in workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py must remain identical to .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py.
  Expected change site: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.p
